offering_description.value: Operates and franchises drive-thru coffee shops that sell espresso and handcrafted beverages, food and merchandise to individual consumers. Drinks are made in-store to order and sold through drive-thru lanes, walk-up windows and mobile app orders.

primary_products.value: espresso and handcrafted coffee drinks; teas and smoothies; bakery and snack food; merchandise

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying drinks and food at drive-thru, walk-up and app orders

end_markets.value: food and beverage retail; quick-service restaurants

revenue_model.value: product sales: coffee drinks, food and merchandise sold at company-operated shops; licensing or royalties: franchise fees and royalties from franchised shop owners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns the brand, recipes and shop system, franchisees operate under it; retailer: sells finished drinks and food directly to consumers at its shops

geography_served.value: US national: Western and Southern US states, including Oregon, Washington, California, Arizona and Texas

specialization.value: niche specialist: drive-thru espresso beverages, with a small range of food and merchandise

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated drive-thru coffee shops; partners / resellers: franchised shops run by independent franchise owners; online: mobile app and online ordering for pickup and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and health department permits for retail food service, plus franchise disclosure rules
